newsitem.title: USA: Warner Chilcott prices 3.5mln shrIPO at $17.50/ADS.
newsitem.headline: Warner Chilcott prices 3.5mln shrIPO at $17.50/ADS.

text.p: Ireland's Warner Chilcott Plc said Friday it priced its initial public offering of 3.5 million American Depositary Shares (ADSs) at $17.50 a share.

The developer of generic pharmaceutical products said it increased the offering's size to 3.5 million from 3 million. It added it sold an additional 250,000 ADSs to Barr Laboratories Inc for $17.50 a share.
A company spokesman said the company will list the ADSs on Nasdaq's national market under the symbol "WCRXY."
The company changed its name to Warner Chilcott from Nal Laboratories Ltd when it bought the Warner Chilcott division of Warner-Lambert Co in 1996.
